summary:
Displays 'str' to the current player. Numbers are converted to strings automatically. Objects can also be displayed normally, but arrays, mappings, function pointers, and buffers are displayed as <ARRAY>, <MAPPING>, <FUNCTION>, and <BUFFER>.

This efun does not call the receive_message() apply. The maximum output length is __LARGEST_PRINTABLE_STRING__, which defaults to 65535 bytes (a Chinese character uses 3 bytes in UTF-8).
